description: Implemented the 160-second, 32-restart simulated-annealing experiment in [solver.py](/Users/williamqian/GitHub/OpenHyra/runs/sums_diffs/trial_04/drafts/iter_0000/solver.py). - Uses deterministic seed `4` - Exact sum/difference scoring - Requested 70/15/15 mutations with size bounds - Atomically checkpoints the best valid solution - Syntax verified; solver not executed - Did not create `PROPOSAL.md` because the final constraint permits modifying only `solver.py`

metadata.direction: Implement a 160-second simulated-annealing search initialized from `sol_0000`, using sets with `12 <= n <= 40` inside `[0,127]`; mutations should replace one element (70%), add one (15%), or delete one (15%), scoring every candidate by exact C(A). Use 32 random restarts, temperature `T=0.02*(1-t/160)`, and always emit the best valid set found.
